summary: Implemented M1-M4 from SPEC-02 exactly as specified. M5 is an audit-only confirmation (no code change required); findings recorded below.

filesChanged.change: Added "engines": { "node": "22.x" } after "license". No other fields touched.
npm install @vercel/functions@^3 --save. Installed version 3.9.9 (matches the plan's pinned verified version). 295 packages added transitively; no other direct dependency was bumped.

Imported attachDatabasePool from @vercel/functions; call attachDatabasePool(pool) guarded by `if (process.env.VERCEL)` right after Pool construction, before drizzle(pool, { schema }). Local/Replit path (process.env.VERCEL unset) is unchanged.

Switched import to `NextResponse, after` from 'next/server'. Deleted the hardcoded Google Chat webhook URL (key+token) from source; the URL now comes only from process.env.GOOGLE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL. When set, the same POST (byte-identical `text` template, same headers/body shape) now runs inside after(async () => {...}), logging console.log('[webhook] delivered', res.status) on res.ok and console.error('[webhook] Failed:', res.status) otherwise, with a try/catch around the fetch so after() never throws (catch logs console.error('[webhook] Failed:', message)). When unset, logs console.warn('[webhook] GOOGLE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL not set; skipping notification'). Response codes/bodies (201 + created row, 400 validation, 500 on error) are unchanged; the success response no longer waits on the webhook fetch (it didn't await it before either).

filesAudited.finding: Already contains .vercel, .env, .env*.local, docs/migration/.scratch/, *.dump (added by the plan-authoring commit). No change made.

m5Confirmations.note: Confirmed the duplication: gsc-indexing-redirects.ts:8-9 defines '/arc' -> '/revenue-platform' and '/arc/ai/connect' -> '/minori-ai/connect', both spread first (...gscIndexingRedirects) in next.config.ts's redirects() array, ahead of next.config.ts's own '/arc' -> '/' (line 10) and '/arc/ai/connect' -> '/minori-ai/connect' (line 20) entries. Next.js redirects() applies first match in array order, so the gsc-indexing-redirects.ts destinations win for those two paths; the next.config.ts entries are dead but harmless. Left as-is per spec. allowedDevOrigins (['*.replit.dev', '*.repl.co', '*.kirk.replit.dev']) is dev-only and harmless per spec; left unchanged.

m5Confirmations.item: middleware.ts works unchanged on Edge runtime with a Neon URL
m5Confirmations.note: Uses @neondatabase/serverless's neon() (HTTP-based, Edge-compatible) against process.env.DATABASE_URL, with a try/catch fail-open on the blog_redirects lookup. No change made here; the only change scheduled for this file is H3 (later step, not in scope for P2.1).

m5Confirmations.item: No app/, components/ or lib/ code reads attached_assets/ or screenshots/
m5Confirmations.note: grep -rn 'attached_assets|screenshots' across app, lib, components, scripts found only scripts/import-missing-blogs.ts:6 (reads attached_assets/*.csv) and scripts/migration/visual/run.mjs (comment mentioning 'screenshots' re: Playwright visual diff tooling, not a data-directory read). Neither is part of the Next.js build.

m5Confirmations.item: app/layout.tsx fonts fetched at build via next/font/google
m5Confirmations.note: IBM_Plex_Sans and IBM_Plex_Mono are loaded via next/font/google in app/layout.tsx; Vercel builders have network access to Google Fonts. No change made.

Reverted with `git checkout -- tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`; confirmed back to HEAD content (md5 e35dc219892a02fc0f1a41361b8e5bea, `git status --porcelain` empty for this path). Re-ran the sanity typecheck with `npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false` (rc=0, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo md5 unchanged), which is the safe command to use for future sanity typechecks since it doesn't write the incremental-cache file.
